You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From cc76404feaed597bb4f5234d34d3f49e2d1139bf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wen Yang <wen.yang99@zte.com.cn>
Date: Tue, 26 Mar 2019 18:29:51 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] powerpc/8xx: Fix possible device node reference leak

The call to of_find_compatible_node() returns a node pointer with
refcount incremented thus it must be explicitly decremented after the
last usage.

irq_domain_add_linear() also calls of_node_get() to increase refcount,
so irq_domain() will not be affected when it is released.

Detected by coccinelle.

Fixes: a8db8cf0d894 ("irq_domain: Replace irq_alloc_host() with revmap-specific initializers")
Signed-off-by: Wen Yang <wen.yang99@zte.com.cn>
Suggested-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Suggested-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
Reviewed-by: Peng Hao <peng.hao2@zte.com.cn>
Reviewed-by: Christophe Leroy <christophe.leroy@c-s.fr>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>

diff --git a/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c b/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
index 8d5a25d43ef3..e9617d35fd1f 100644
--- a/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
+++ b/arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c
@@ -153,10 +153,9 @@ int mpc8xx_pic_init(void)
 	if (mpc8xx_pic_host == NULL) {
 		printk(KERN_ERR "MPC8xx PIC: failed to allocate irq host!\n");
 		ret = -ENOMEM;
-		goto out;
 	}
-	return 0;
 
+	ret = 0;
 out:
 	of_node_put(np);
 	return ret;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/powerpc/platforms/8xx/pic.c`**
   - The code block that handles the return value of the function `mpc8xx_pic_init()` has been modified. 
   - The `return 0;` statement has been removed, and instead, the variable `ret` is set to `0` before the `out` label.
   - The `of_node_put(np);` call is now placed under the `out` label, ensuring that the reference to the device node is decremented before returning the value of `ret`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification ensures that the reference count of the device node is properly managed. By moving the `of_node_put(np);` call to the `out` label, it guarantees that the reference is decremented regardless of the execution path taken in the function. This change addresses a potential memory leak by ensuring that every increment of the reference count (from `of_find_compatible_node()` and `irq_domain_add_linear()`) is matched with a corresponding decrement. The overall logic flow is preserved while enhancing resource management.

        Root cause:
        The bug is caused by a reference count leak in the device node management. The function `of_find_compatible_node()` increments the reference count of the returned node pointer, but the original code did not ensure that this reference was decremented before the function returned, leading to a potential memory leak. The modification ensures that the reference is properly released, preventing the leak.
